subject: Ariadne Systems — capacity signal & soft-hold for late-stage POC
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ariadne POC — quick inventory & soft-hold ask

Team,

Late-stage POC with Ariadne is moving to contract talks this week. Lina (Ariadne) told me they expect ramping inference load starting ~June 10 if we can guarantee staging performance for the two-week pilot. They want a short safety window (30–60 days) after go-live.

Can ops confirm current available capacity across A100-80 and H100 pools for the period Jun 1–Jul 31 and advise if we can place a soft hold (no billing commitment, just allocation reservation) on the required nodes? Baseline ask from Lina: 8x A100-80GB and 4x H100 (burstable). Prioritize us-west regions.

Please attach the inventory snapshot and outline any risk windows (maintenance, quota conflicts, known bookings). If we can accommodate, I’ll ask Legal to draft a short MOU-style hold with the sales terms.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Ariadne POC — quick inventory & soft-hold ask

Evelyn / team,

Attached: capacity-inventory-20290521.csv (snapshot across clusters us-west-1/us-west-2). High-level:
- A100-80: 42 total nodes; 12 currently committed to long-term Dedicated (reserved), 10 in short-term holds (30–90 days). ~20 available for allocation; can safely allocate 8 for a 30–60d soft hold with standard guardrails.
- H100: 16 total nodes; 8 committed to scheduled experiments (June 5–12), 4 spare capacity in us-west, 4 in other regions. With a 30d soft hold we can promise 4 H100s if we schedule around the maintenance windows.

Risks: maintenance planned Jun 3–4 (kernel upgrades) in us-west-2 which will reduce burst capacity for 24h. We can work around by shifting some H100 instances to us-west-1 but that increases latency ~12–20ms.

I recommend:
1) Place a soft hold for 8 A100-80 and 4 H100 (us-west preference) for Jun 1–Jul 31, with opt-out if internal priority demand rises (48h notice).
2) Flag Jun 3–4 as a restricted window and offer Ash-staging in us-west-1 if Ariadne needs zero-disruption tests.

Attaching inventory CSV and a short terms draft (proposed-soft-hold-terms.pdf).

—Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Capacity Planner
Redwood Inference
Attachments: capacity-inventory-20290521.csv; proposed-soft-hold-terms.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Ariadne POC — quick inventory & soft-hold ask

Ben — thanks for snapshot. A few asks from product/serving side before we confirm the hold:
- Can we reserve these nodes with pinned kernel/driver versions (we need the older NV driver set for one of Ariadne’s models). If not, we need a rollback plan.
- KV-cache warmup: do we have a runbook to pre-warm embeddings/cache into the staging cluster prior to their test? That will affect how quickly they hit stable latency.
- Operationally, define the fallback route: if H100s aren't available during peak, can we transparently route to quantized A100 variants? Cost and perf delta should be communicated to the customer now.

If ops can confirm pinned-image availability and a short warmup runbook, I’m comfortable approving the soft hold.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Ariadne POC — quick inventory & soft-hold ask

Karthik — quick answers inline: 
- Pinned images: yes, we can reserve nodes with the 510.x NV driver and a stable container image. That requires a 12h lead to spin and validate; note we can’t guarantee pinned images on burst nodes that flip regions.
- Warmup runbook: attached short checklist to pre-populate KV and embeddings into staging (we’ll also provide a script). We’ll need customer credentials and a small ingest window (2–3 hours) to warm the cache.
- Fallback: we can route to 4x quantized A100s with explicit perf delta documented (approx +18% latency and -12% quality on edge-case prompt set). Ops will only trigger fallback with 1h notice to sales/SEs.

I’ll mark the inventory as provisionally reserved after we get signed MOU from Legal.

—Ben
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2029 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Ariadne POC — quick inventory & soft-hold ask

Quick FYI — platform team just surfaced an Ops change-control: maintenance on the us-west-2 H100 subnet now shows 06/03 02:00–08:00 UTC extended window (was 24h, now 6h block with risk of rolling to 12h if a firmware regression is found). That increases the risk we flagged. If Ariadne requires uninterrupted H100 availability during that window, we should propose a staggered test window or move their staging to us-west-1 as Ben suggested.

I’ll block a short maintenance-avoidance run with infra if we confirm the hold — they can temporarily tile affected workloads to us-west-1. But we need decision + MOU signed by Friday 5/31 to lock the runway.

Marcus Lin | Staff Engineer, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Lina Gomez <lina@ariadne.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Ariadne POC — quick inventory & soft-hold ask

Thanks all — Lina here. Appreciate the level of detail and the proposed soft-hold flow. A few items from our side:

- We can accept a Jun 1–Jul 31 soft hold with the maintenance caveat; please document the Jun 3–4 window in the MOU.
- We need the pinned driver for one model; we will provide the container sha and a 2-hour window Jun 7 for warmup.
- Please include an explicit fallback clause in the MOU that states fallback to quantized A100s may be used with 1h notice and that Redwood will provide perf regression numbers for our test prompts.

If Legal sends the MOU snapshot today, we’ll review and return with a signature by EOD Friday. Looking forward to the staging run.

Best,
Lina Gomez
VP Product | Ariadne Systems
